staug.reason: Plaza de la Constitución frames the historic center, bayfront and Bridge of Lions, with the Castillo just north.

st-augustine-beach.reason: The mapped beach pier anchors the public oceanfront, beach streets and low resort blocks.

ponte-vedra-beach.reason: Ponte Vedra Inn and Club frames the oceanfront resort, golf lagoons and low residential streets.

jaxbeach.reason: Jacksonville Beach Fishing Pier anchors the boardwalk, beachside hotels and walkable center.

neptune-beach.reason: The ocean end of Beaches Town Center frames Neptune’s beach cottages, shops and shared Atlantic Boulevard center.

atlantic-beach.reason: Howell Park frames Atlantic Beach’s shaded residential streets, nearby ocean and Beaches Town Center.

fernandina.reason: Fernandina Harbor Marina frames Centre Street’s historic brick blocks and working Amelia River waterfront.

vilano-beach.reason: Vilano Beach Pier frames the small waterfront center, inlet and nearby Atlantic beach.

crescent-beach.reason: The mapped ocean end of Cubbedge Road frames Crescent Beach’s public access, beach homes and narrow barrier island.
